author: Jarrod Castillo
title: Drake Maye breaks silence with Mike Vrabel statement after Dianna Russini scandal - NewsBreak
text:
By Jarrod Castillo ,
44 minutes ago Drake Maye has shared his thoughts on the situation Mike Vrabel, the New England Patriots head coach, finds himself in after pictures of him with Dianna Russini caused a scandal.
The Patriots ' offseason was upended when bombshell photos of Vrabel and Russini, the former NFL insider, getting cozy at an adults-only resort in Arizona were published. Then photos emerged of the pair appearing to be kissing in a bar six years ago.
Maye has now made sure his coach knew that he had his back amid the turbulence after Vrabel addressed the situation with his players , while his wife made a statement wedding ring choice.

• Cleveland Browns coach flabbergasted by Shedeur Sanders question during NFL Draft
"Yeah, we're here for Coach," Maye said to WHDH-TV. "We love Coach. You know, what he does for us, what he's done for us this past year, you can't speak into words and just thankful he's our head coach.
"I know he's doing some stuff off the field and out of the coaching world, but we're here for him and I know he's going to come back."
Aside from Maye's statement, the Patriots organization has remained relatively mum regarding the situation Vrabel finds himself in . A source told the Daily Mail that the head coach feels "responsible" for Russini losing her job at The Athletic and potentially her career in sports journalism.
"Mike feels terrible on many levels, especially since Dianna's career is pretty much over, and that blood is on his hands," the source told the outlet. "He feels terrible that he is responsible and that she may never be able to work again."
As for Russini, the former NFL insider reportedly is focusing on repairing her family and undoing the damage inflicted. Russini and Vrabel are both married.
"Dianna is a bit shellshocked by it all and has not really shown her hand in all of this, as it has been a very intense situation that she is still trying to figure out and feel out," the source continued.
• NFL news as Mike Vrabel's wife spotted, ROTY odds released
• Mike Vrabel addressed elephant in the room with players after Dianna Russini scandal
"She's neither here nor there right now as the dust hasn't settled one bit. Nobody including herself knows what the next move for her will be.
"One thing she is mainly focusing on is being a mom and to protect her kids through all of this madness."
As the fallout continues for both parties, Vrabel explained to reporters that he is working on himself and took for the firestorm that has erupted as a result of his alleged relationship with Russini being exposed.
"I take accountability for my actions and the actions and distractions that hurt the people I care most about - my family and this football team, the organization and our fans," the head coach said. "My previous actions do not meet the standards I hold myself too.
"I think the best steps is for myself and this football team is for us to work together and give them what I told them I would - the best version of me. I want to give them the best version of me possible."
